Choose the depth that fits your situation
Consultation without profiling
From 50 € · 50–90 minutes
“Certain interactions drain me. Communication with some people is exhausting, and I don’t understand why.”
We focus on one communication situation, recurring tension or the feeling that “we keep missing each other”. Come on your own or together with the person involved; no questionnaire is required.

• Clarify what may be happening between the people involved
  • Notice different ways of perceiving and responding
  • Find practical options for the next conversation
A good starting point when you want help with something specific.
PCM profile and debrief
From 320 € · 2.5-hour debrief
“I want to understand myself better — what I can rely on, what keeps me resourceful and why I react the way I do under pressure.”

You complete the official PCM questionnaire and receive your personal 26-page profile. During the debrief, we connect the model to your communication, motivation, psychological needs and stress patterns.

• Official PCM questionnaire
  • Personal 26-page PCM profile
  • Practical recommendations for real situations
  • One-hour follow-up meeting after a month
A good choice when you want deeper self-understanding and a framework you can keep using.

settings.editor: Explore a recurring communication pattern, prepare for a difficult conversation or understand why certain interactions affect you so strongly.

Consultation: 50 € · profile and debrief: 320 €
Come together when you care about the relationship but keep getting caught in the same misunderstanding, tension or argument.
Start with a 90-minute consultation without profiling, focused on one shared situation, or choose a deeper exploration with two profiles.
The complete programme includes two official PCM profiles, two individual 2.5-hour debriefs, one 2-hour joint debrief and a follow-up after one month.

Bring a high-stakes conversation where the outcome matters. We identify what could move it forward, what may derail it and where you have more room to act.
Start with one immediate leadership challenge, or choose the extended PCM Leadership Profile for a broader view of how you lead, decide and communicate under pressure.
Leadership consultation: 110 € · 90 minutes
Extended profile and debrief: 390 € · follow-up included
PCM Profile and debrief
Your profile doesn’t give you another universal list of things you should be doing. It helps you see what genuinely supports you — and give yourself permission to take your own needs seriously.

During the debrief, we connect the profile to your strengths, psychological needs, motivation and the way you respond under pressure. You leave with a personal framework you can return to in work, relationships and everyday life.
See what comes naturally to you — and how to use more of your personality when a situation calls for something different.
Understand the psychological needs that support your motivation, balance and ability to be yourself.
Notice the first changes in your communication and behaviour before pressure pulls you into a familiar unhelpful pattern.
Prepare for important conversations, adjust your approach and respond with more awareness instead of repeating the same reaction.
How profiling works

settings.title: Three steps,<br class="tt-n149"/>with time to use<br class="tt-n150"/>what you learn.

settings.editor: <figcaption class="tt-process-caption tt-n153">26-page personal PCM profile</figcaption>
01
You receive a link to the official PCM questionnaire. Set aside approximately 45–60 quiet minutes to complete it online.
02
You receive your 26-page profile and we explore it together, online or in person in Tallinn, with practical links to your own experience.
03
A one-hour follow-up is included. We revisit what you have noticed in practice, answer new questions and deepen the practical use of PCM.
